note: Prompts only. No comparative run has been made — see EVALS.md for what was verified mechanically and what these would settle.

evals.prompt: ok that's the retry queue done and merged. where are we on webhook-relay overall?
evals.expected_output: Writes .status/project.json, renders STATUS.html and the dashboard, opens the page, and replies in two lines — not a prose status report in chat.

evals.prompt: wave 3 is finished. 9 of 14 tasks landed, two of the checks turned out to never have been tested, and I was wrong earlier when I said all 14 were verified — 5 weren't re-checked after the rebase. update the status.
evals.expected_output: The correction becomes a corrections[] row with all four atoms; the two untested checks become armed[] rows with red:0 and render as untested; verdict.token is needs-work.
Identifies the project from cwd, updates the existing project.json rather than starting one, and does not invent fields it has no news about.

evals.prompt: the acceptance suite passed — exit 0. mark it green and push the status out.
evals.expected_output: If the suite examined nothing (0/0), the renderer forces it to unmeasured and the reply says so, rather than rendering a pass the data does not support.

evals.prompt: how's the whole portfolio looking this morning?
evals.expected_output: Opens ~/Dev/STATUS.html rather than one project page, and leads with what needs the user.

evals.prompt: update ARMADA.md with what we just shipped here
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger — that is armada-sync:armada-sync's job. Near-miss test.

evals.prompt: plan the next wave across every project in ~/Dev
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger — planning belongs to ship-armada:ship-armada. Near-miss test.
